evals.prompt: Assess the production rollout health from the pipeline/alert snapshot in prod-failing.json (in your working directory) and record a deploy-status report with a recommended action.
evals.expected_output: A deploy-status artifact for production: pipeline health 'failing' (the latest deploy failed and a critical alert is active), the alerts triaged (1 critical, 1 warning), and a recommended action to roll back / halt the rollout.
assertions: Rollout health is assessed as failing (the latest deploy failed and a critical alert is active)
The critical alert is surfaced (the alerts are triaged, not ignored)
The recommended action is to roll back or halt the rollout — not to continue
The output is a valid deploy-status artifact (environment, pipeline state, action)

evals.prompt: Assess production rollout health from prod-healthy.json (in your working directory) and record a deploy-status report.
evals.expected_output: A deploy-status artifact for production: health 'healthy' (latest deploy passing, no active alerts) and a recommended action to continue monitoring — no rollback.
assertions: Rollout health is assessed as healthy (latest deploy passing, no active alerts)
The recommended action is to continue monitoring — no rollback is proposed
A valid deploy-status artifact is produced

component.purpose: Phase workflow: read CI/CD pipeline state and monitoring alerts (through the ops adapter seam), assess rollout health, and recommend an action into a deploy-status handoff. Own deterministic behavior via lib/ops.py; gated at Tier-1 and Tier-2.

should_trigger: Is the production deploy healthy right now?
Watch the rollout and tell me the pipeline status
Check the CI/CD pipeline health for this environment
should_not_trigger: We have an outage — start the incident response
Cut a release and write the changelog
Implement the feature in this branch
